name: vLLM waiting-request gauge split by cause
notes: vLLM main, PrometheusStatLogger in vllm/v1/metrics/loggers.py, read 2026-10-04. On by default (EngineArgs.disable_log_stats defaults False); served at :8000/metrics. Bucket family name in --custom-histogram-buckets: no bucket family. reason in {capacity, deferred}. Documented invariant: 'Sum of all reasons equals vllm:num_requests_waiting'. Unique in this fleet: it separates 'no capacity' from 'deferred by LoRA budget, KV transfer or blocked status', which are different problems with different fixes.
